n1.text:
What changed from the live site
• Weather, date and Light/Dark moved to a slim top bar
• Search + a 'Submit a claim' button in the header
• ALERT stories get an amber banner
• Fact checks get their own green band with a claim-submission card
• Top Stories tabs work (try them), with an empty state
• Contrast fixed: small green text uses forest, not leaf
• Footer now has sections, contact and social links
• Photos are placeholders: drop in the real images

n2.text:
Inner pages
• Header and Footer are shared components (bottom row): edit once, every inner page updates
• Article: breadcrumb, share bar, 'At a glance' summary, pull quote, tags, corrections link, comments, related stories
• Fact check: Claim / Verdict panel up top, sources box, share incl. WhatsApp
• Fact Check archive: topic filters work (try them), author, date and reading time on every row, pagination
• About + Contact: the site had no Contact page; contact now routes by topic to the same inbox
• Click through in Play: nav, breadcrumbs and 'See all' links connect the pages
• Submit a claim: a real form (claim, platform, country, link, file upload, optional contact) with a thank-you state. Every 'Submit a claim' button now leads here
